name: Rejuvenating Shadows raises raid healing taken and Bloodbolt's leech multiplier (#3917)
contract: Rejuvenating Shadows 704623 ships two effects in Spell.dbc. Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (Spell::EffectApplyAreaAura) with aura 118 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT, BasePoints 5 + DieSides 1 = 6%, MiscValue 127, radius index 23 and TargetA 1, so the caster carries the area aura itself; the native consumer is Unit::SpellHealingBonusTaken's GetMaxPositiveAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT). Effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50%, MiscValue 27 = SPELLMOD_VALUE_MULTIPLIER, SpellClassMask (0, 131072, 0), which matches exactly the eight Bloodbolt ranks (578304, 578305, 804685, 806928-806932) and nothing else in family 26; SpellEffectInfo::CalcValueMultiplier feeds that op and Spell.cpp consumes it as Bloodbolt's SPELL_EFFECT_HEALTH_LEECH heal multiplier. 578305 is the Bloodbolt rank a level-80 character owns. The harness has no healing-taken metric, so the 6% half is locked through the applied aura's amount rather than through an observed heal.

steps.label: Bloodbolt's leech multiplier is unmodified before the talent
Rejuvenating Shadows raises Bloodbolt's leech multiplier to 1.50
It does not touch an unrelated Bloodmage spell
The raid aura lands on its own caster
The raid healing-taken bonus is the shipped 6%
